lab.title: Laboratory desk
lab.help.add: Find a patient using their Aadhaar, ABHA, email or phone number.
lab.help.verify: Confirm the matched patient and correct their details before proceeding.
lab.help.report: Attach the report to the verified patient.
lab.help.processing: Your report is being processed and saved to the patient record.
lab.help.complete: The report and its activity log are now part of the patient’s history.
lab.noMatch: No match found. Add the basic patient details below.
lab.confirmDetails: I have checked these details with the patient and confirmed this is the correct person.
lab.consent: The patient has authorized uploading, processing and storing this lab report.
lab.fileHelp: PDF, JPG or PNG · Maximum 10 MB
lab.failed: Processing failed. The upload remains recorded.
lab.statusError: Unable to check report status. Refresh to try again.
lab.savedHelp: The patient can view the report in Documents. The history records who uploaded it and when processing finished.
lab.privacyHelp: Only confirm the patient in front of you. Laboratory access is limited to identifying patients and adding lab reports.
lab.pipelineHelp: Reports use the existing document-processing pipeline. This installation uses demo OCR; extracted results require clinical verification.
